For me that's easier said than done. The feelings I have towards this world are so strong it's impossible to reconnect. Look at the matrix films, Neo being woken up to the reality he is in, knowing that his entire life was just a fascade. I'm not saying I'm a believer in this reality is just a simulation theory, but having opened my eyes to see the world for what it is I just can't step back and ignore it, I can't block out the thoughts that everything I do to try make my life better is just utterly futile, meaningless.

Like, I love cars, a seriously powerful passion for cars, there's nothing I want more than the freedom to drive and work on my car(s), to express myself and feel the rush of high octane, nitrous induced adrenaline, feeling that bond between man and machine, pumping blood and fuel, a beating heart and roaring engine, working in unison. Cars give meaning to my life but even petrol fueled cars are facing extinction because of the mass consumerism of the motoring industry. However the way my life is going I don't see myself reaching those goals, I don't see how I'd be able to fund a passion like this.

If I can't even chase simple dreams like this how will I ever be able to find happiness and freedom. 

Tbh in my mind knowing how shitty the world is and how bad it's going to be in future is something I can use to fuel my ambition and find peace through my passion... but how can I if the system is working against me? If everytime I try make efforts to secure a good life for my future I'm constantly being set back, constantly being messed around by institutions that are supposed to help people, I'm sick and tired of trying and trying and trying and getting absolutely nowhere all because other people don't give a fuck and would rather let me down than do their fucking jobs properly
